title: The Tiny Mustard Seed
reflectionQuestion: What do you think the little birds felt, building their nests high in the branches of that great and beautiful tree?
kidSafetyNotes: PARABLE. SHORT-ONLY by design -- a 2-verse parable; a 'full' would require padding (honor its brevity, per length-bucket doctrine). 'God grows small things into something great and good and beautiful.' Gentle, no peril. One image: the seed too small to see -> the great tree with birds nesting in its branches.
